title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval of the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Agreement with Hallmark Health System, Inc., d/b/a Melrose-Wakefiled Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds also, that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., W. Robert Keating and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-22)
